name: Hybrid KDA + MLA-NoPE
tagline: Three Kimi Delta Attention blocks, then one latent-attention block.
description: Repeats KDA, KDA, KDA, full causal MLA-NoPE across 24 layers. KDA keeps the linear family's decay gate, output gate, causal convolution and chunked backend; MLA-NoPE uses a 768-rank query latent, a 256-rank joint key/value latent, 12 heads of 128 and no rotary dimensions. Value embeddings are removed throughout, with independently calibrated controls for each component.
paperTitle: Kimi Linear: An Expressive, Efficient Attention Architecture
mechanism: MLA-NoPE: query latent 768, joint KV latent 256, 12 heads, QK/V dimensions 128, no RoPE
FFN 6016; value embeddings and their gates removed; one joint stage
limitations: A registered adaptation, not the released Kimi model: Kimi uses no query compression, a 512-rank KV latent, 32 heads, an extra shared key component and different KDA gating. Paired controls: KDA without value embeddings, MLA-NoPE, and MHA without value embeddings. Registered and admitted within the shared budget; no formal result is published yet. Parameters, memory and speed are outcomes, not controls.
